search_text: published ZDI-20-682 ZDI-CAN-10504 Apple Safari HasIndexedProperty Type Confusion Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-05-28 CVE-2020-9800 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-9800 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Apple'] ['Safari'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Apple Safari. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the HasIndexedProperty DFG node. By performing actions in JavaScript, an attacker can trigger a type confusion condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. https://support.apple.com/en-gb/HT211177 ['2020-02-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2020-05-28 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Brendan Draper (@6r3nd4n) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-20-682/
title: Apple Safari HasIndexedProperty Type Confusion Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Apple Safari. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the HasIndexedProperty DFG node. By performing actions in JavaScript, an attacker can trigger a type confusion condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
